# Bracken Exchange Bank hidden-style fixture

Shape: newest-first signed email thread, base operating card and separate code list. Fictional bank and non-routable `.example.invalid` API; intended for offline extraction/compilation evaluation, not the fixed public-customer mock.

Feed **only** `01-mail-thread.txt`, `02-operating-card.md`, `03-codes.txt` in that order, with `openapi.json`. Never feed `expected.json`, `expected-api.json`, `date-probes.json` or this README as bank instructions.

Targets: Four identity formats reordered by final mail; five-error API counter; Sunday–Thursday calendar; eleven-calendar-day following adjustment and business month-end; two extra retries; restored human ask-once; hardship note-and-continue with voluntary promise; renamed request and response fields.

`expected.json` contains 134 effective-rule checks using the existing synthetic projection format. `expected-api.json` covers field mappings outside PolicyIR. `date-probes.json` contains 20 calls and results computed directly with bankcal (no manually calculated expected dates). Outcome reason sets are compared without order; identity and offer order matter. The oracle was authored without running extraction. Exact quoted mandatory sentences are checked; suggested identity question paraphrases and trigger prose need semantic review.

The last signed email changes five setting groups and expressly reverses the morning callback/human experiments. Physical file order is not precedence. Refusal after a saved promise finalizes using the promise outcome; product notes do not erase writes.

Validation: hand-authored effective values deserialize and pass policy.validate against the exact API enum roles; all date probes are replayable offline. No extractor, builder, simulation or Freya API has been run. Uncertainties: equivalent special-case encodings may need semantic adjudication; this fixture does not assert how a particular model will paraphrase non-mandatory prose.
